saved_model: C16, full 2215-coordinate descriptor, literal Daedalus at 6.7 m/s with native F3 input

formulas.pair_state: z_pair(s)=(v*b)/(s-lambda)+conj(v*b)/(s-conj(lambda)), s=i*2*pi*f; one native F3 input unit.
formulas.node_coordinates: First 702 solver coordinates reshaped (117,6): body-relative translations times retained L=115.5794531913004 ft; infinitesimal spatial rotation-vector components are already radians.
formulas.frame: Saved coordinates: velocity times U=60.98644770517502 ft/s, body rate times W=0.527658212781417 rad/s, Earth position times L, Euler attitude in radians. Coordinates are recovered directly, not obtained by differentiating other partial coordinates.
formulas.cycle_peak_vector: For complex three-vector h=a+i*b, peak_t norm(Re(h*exp(i*omega*t))) = sqrt((aa+bb+sqrt((aa-bb)^2+4ab^2))/2), aa=a.a, bb=b.b, ab=a.b. Select maximum node peak within each beam; this is a dimensional motion-component measure, not energy.
formulas.output_map: Retained C rows yaw rate, roll rate, sideslip derivative, bank; compare recovered values against the accepted pair output contribution at the same saved frequencies.

limits: An individual forced modal state contribution is a decomposition of the full response, not a standalone aircraft solution.
Its kinematic rows have projected forcing; partial velocities/rates need not equal i*omega times partial displacement/attitude. No such identity is imposed or inferred.
Node translations are in body coordinates relative to the aircraft frame; they are not total Earth-frame point motion. Spatial rotations are infinitesimal coordinate contributions.
Beam maxima describe dimensional displacement and rotation components, not physical energy participation or a standalone vibration amplitude.
No new eigenvalue query, factorization, physical residual/assembly call, harmonic solve, or integration. Retained root query artifacts remain unchanged.
Full2215-coordinate C16 saved-pencil numerical residue verification only.
Exactly16 forced resolvent RHS; condition-estimator inverse/adjoint RHS are separately counted and reuse the same16LU factors.
The reciprocal condition is an estimate, not a certified lower bound.
No complete-spectrum, physical-mode-validity, original-ASWING parity or Bode-match claim.

finite_grid_uncertainties: The saved beam scheme uses objective rotation-log midpoints and midpoint property sampling; the primary steady theory describes nodal Euler/arithmetic averaging and nodal compliance. Their finite-grid equivalence is unproved.

Historical computational-break settings and the actual reference mesh are unknown. The audit found display-only shell break locations affected the saved native grid. A separate correction is under validation; no result or response effect of that correction is asserted here.

Multi-point spline endpoint conventions remain uncertain for wing and rudder properties. Literal tailboom two-point property segments are linear, so that endpoint ambiguity does not affect those interpolants.

Historical finite-arc aerodynamic interpolation is not uniquely established by the available text. Native refinement also changes spacing-limited interaction cores, so it is not a fixed-core convergence test.
No new omitted physical term or literal control/property scale error was demonstrated. The existing 16-to-32-panel sampled yaw minimum changes only about 0.33% and still misses the reference depth.
pending_separate_work: Display-only shell-break mesh dependency correction is being validated separately; this report includes no result for it.
limits: No complete-spectrum or physical-mode validation claim.
No matched-reference or aircraft-accuracy claim; published operating point, mesh, phase and historical executable settings remain unresolved.
Partial sums are not full responses. The unselected remainder includes everything not represented by these isolated terms.
Motion values are components of a forced state decomposition, not standalone aircraft solutions or energy measures.

model.scope: Literal Daedalus wing, rudder and tailboom parsing/interpolation/discrete kinematic conventions; read-only.

conclusions.statement: Objective SO(3) midpoint/rotation-log and material-midpoint compliance differ from documented arithmetic/Euler/nodal-average equations; causal response effect unmeasured.
Constant jig triads make full-material and deformation geodesic interpolation equivalent on the same log branch. Receiver location and constitutive midpoint remain distinct.

Native inserts all property breaks, including display-only shell breaks; documented computational-break policy is KBREAK-dependent with zero-length intervals. Saved C16 confirms wing/rudder/tailboom counts34/19/21.
Tailboom property segments and geometry are linear, so natural-end ambiguity cannot affect them. Wing/rudder multi-point stiffness segments remain subject to it.
Rudder control produces -0.01745 rad incidence per native F3; no second degree conversion, active wing F3, swapped named stiffness column or extra literal multiplier found.

limitations: Source audit cannot identify actual historical ASWING INDEXB.INC/NODE/.set settings or undocumented spline endpoints.
Accepted independent continuum tests use the implemented natural interpolation and do not prove historical discrete parity.
No finding is established as cause of the near-1-Hz mismatch; reference operating point remains unresolved.
No broad compatibility claim for other ASW files, no parameter tuning, no new scientific execution.

aerodynamics.scope: Finite-deformed wing/fin aerodynamic motion/load coupling near 1 Hz; source and saved metadata only

wake_core.rule: max(ratio * local chord, current interval length)
wake_core.scope: Lifting-surface interactions within one physical beam use zero core. Distinct physical beams and external probes/objects use the configured cores; images inherit the selected influence core.
